PRODUCT_NAME: PerkinElmer Quartz Baffled Cyclonic Spray Chamber for ELAN DRC/DRCplus/DRC II
DESCRIPTION:
The spray chamber is an integral part of the sample introduction system responsible for filtering the sample mist to permit the appropriate droplet size distribution to reach the plasma. The baffled cyclonic spray chamber features a central transfer tube which acts as a secondary particle separator helping separate larger aerosol particles from the sample. This reduces solvent load in the plasma without compromising detection limits. The distance between the bottom of the baffle and the chamber wall is carefully controlled so that droplets cannot form on the bottom of the baffle. The advantage is smooth draining and improved precision.

• 290-15236 and 290-15563 will connect to ESI injector directly, an adapter is needed for other injectors

The Coris web portal provides current temperatures from the ETS sensors, as well as the ability to graph the temperature history over any time frame, starting from when the sensor was installed.

Model YDP 10-0CE is a data printer designed to receive weighing data from a connected weighing instrument and print it on plain paper (roll width: 57.5 mm). Text and data are printed with up to 24 characters per line. The data printer meets the quality standards for research in the chemical and pharmaceutical industries, in compliance with the requirements of GLP (Good Laboratory Practice) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice).

The printer can be used for output of weighing data. Data is sent to the output port either automatically or at the press of a key. The printer can be used as auxiliary equipment with a weighing instrument that has been verified for use in legal metrology.

• Interface cable for connecting the printer to a weighing instrument (Not included in Bluetooth Model)
• Ink ribbon
• Paper roll
• 4 rechargeable batteries
• Power supply unit (country specific- see accessories) (Included with Bluetooth Model only)

Text and data are printed with up to 24 characters per line. The data printer meets the quality standards for research in the chemical and pharmaceutical industries, in compliance with the requirements of GLP (Good Laboratory Practice) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice).

The printer can be used for output of weighing data. Data is sent to the output port either automatically or at the press of a key. The printer can be used as auxiliary equipment with a weighing instrument that has been verified for use in legal metrology.

PRODUCT_NAME: PK25 DIRECT INJECTION SLEEVE 1.5MM
DESCRIPTION: General description  Inlet liner is an important part within the injection port. The prime functions of inlet liner are to limit sample degradation and improve vaporisation along with correctly positioning the syringe needle. A wrong choice of liner can have prominent effect on the chromatogram. The basic problems related with incorrect choice of liner include the higher potential of peak tailing and mass discrimination. The inlet liner volume is recommended to be larger than the amount of sample injected by syringe so as to avoid any reaction with the sample.  Injector port liner is suitable to make connection between sample introduction and GC column. Direct type has narrow bore which sustains a high linear velocity through the injection port to diminish band broadening and transferring all the samples to column.  Deactivated (silanized) glass inlet liner for capillary injection ports.   Fits Agilent (5890, 6890, and 7890)<

Bell-type low frequency response is achieved by simply holding the chestpiece in place with light pressure. Firm pressure will produce diaphragm-type high frequency performance. ADSOFT deluxe PVC eartips in small and large size for the ultimate in wearing comfort and acoustic seal. Spare diaphragm included. Scope ID tag included. Adult scope weighs 4.9 oz, Child scope weighs 3.8 oz. Overall length 30.5". Lifetime warranty.. S

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Cubis Data printer, includes RS232 cable
PRODUCT_NAME: Cubis Data printer, includes RS232 cable
DESCRIPTION:
Model YDP 10-0CE is a data printer designed to receive weighing data from a connected weighing instrument and print it on plain paper (roll width: 57.5 mm). Text and data are printed with up to 24 characters per line. The data printer meets the quality standards for research in the chemical and pharmaceutical industries, in compliance with the requirements of GLP (Good Laboratory Practice) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice).

The printer can be used for output of weighing data. Data is sent to the output port either automatically or at the press of a key. The printer can be used as auxiliary equipment with a weighing instrument that has been verified for use in legal metrology.

Included:
• Interface cable for connecting the printer to a weighing instrument (Not included in Bluetooth Model)
• Ink ribbon
• Paper roll
• 4 rechargeable batteries
• Power supply unit (country specific- see accessories) (Included with Bluetooth Model only)

Specifications:
• Length 230 mm
• Width 158 mm
• Height 80 mm
• Weight (without batteries or paper roll): Approximately 800 g
• Operating temperature: 0 DEG C to +40 DEG C (32 DEG F to 104 DEG F)
• Allowable storage temperature: -40 DEG C to +70 DEG C (-40 DEG F to +158 DEG F)

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: PerkinElmer Quartz Baffled Cyclonic Spray Chamber with Gas Port for ELAN 5000/6x00/9000/DRCs PC3 Systems
PRODUCT_NAME: PerkinElmer Quartz Baffled Cyclonic Spray Chamber with Gas Port for ELAN 5000/6x00/9000/DRCs PC3 Systems
DESCRIPTION:
The spray chamber is an integral part of the sample introduction system responsible for filtering the sample mist to permit the appropriate droplet size distribution to reach the plasma. The baffled cyclonic spray chamber features a central transfer tube which acts as a secondary particle separator helping separate larger aerosol particles from the sample. This reduces solvent load in the plasma without compromising detection limits. The distance between the bottom of the baffle and the chamber wall is carefully controlled so that droplets cannot form on the bottom of the baffle. The advantage is smooth draining and improved precision.

• 290-15236 and 290-15563 will connect to ESI injector directly, an adapter is needed for other injectors

DESCRIPTION:
The BRAND® HandyStep® touch is the first electronic repeating pipette with touchscreen operation and automatic tip ejection With a user interface inspired by smartphones, the BRAND® HandyStep® touch delivers all of the advantages of touchscreen efficiency to your laboratory: access functions with a simple swipe, important information is always in view, and integrated help functions are just a tap away. • Simple tip ejection - fully electronic tip ejection reduces the risk of contamination
• Favorites function - save complex processes to avoid repetitive programming of frequently used procedures
• Automatically recognizes tip size of BRAND® PD-Tips® II and is also compatible with tips from other manufacturers
• Improved aspiration and dispensing speed control
• Optional induction charging stand - USB cable provided with pipette

• Sequential Dispensing Mode - Dispense up to 10 different volumes
• Multi-Aspirating Mode - Consecutive aspiration of the same or different volumes
• Titration Mode - Save the last titration result
• Switch between select modes with a filled tip - pipetting settings are saved

PRODUCT_NAME: PerkinElmer Quartz Baffled Cyclonic Spray Chamber without Gas Port for ELAN 5000/6x00/9000/DRCs PC3 Systems
DESCRIPTION:
The spray chamber is an integral part of the sample introduction system responsible for filtering the sample mist to permit the appropriate droplet size distribution to reach the plasma. The baffled cyclonic spray chamber features a central transfer tube which acts as a secondary particle separator helping separate larger aerosol particles from the sample. This reduces solvent load in the plasma without compromising detection limits. The distance between the bottom of the baffle and the chamber wall is carefully controlled so that droplets cannot form on the bottom of the baffle. The advantage is smooth draining and improved precision.

• 290-15236 and 290-15563 will connect to ESI injector directly, an adapter is needed for other injectors

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Crude Fiber Apparatus, 6-places, 115V
PRODUCT_NAME: Crude Fiber Apparatus, 6-places, 115V
DESCRIPTION:
Crude Fiber Apparatus is used in the determination of crude fiber in feed, food and other agricultural products.
It is widely used by state, federal and industrial control labs and is listed by AOAC International. Six samples may be processed at one time.

Features:
• Sturdy anodized aluminum framework supports the manifold.
• Six 350 watt heaters
• Six infinite control knobs direct the variable heat input from 20-100% of capacity.
• Spring compression connections between the beakers and condenser elements hold the beakers in place, preventing bumping and possible breakage when boiling begins.
• Stainless steel condensers have inverted cone bases. These cones direct the condensate back toward the sides of the beakers, which helps wash down froth and fiber that may adhere to the beaker sides.
• Twelve tall-form, straight-sided 600 ml beakers, of durable thick-wall borosilicate glass, are provided.
• 35 11/16 inches wide, 9 inches deep, 27 3/16 inches high
• 137 lbs. shipping weight
